strategies.name: vwap_session_mean_reversion
strategies.entry_summary: Use VWAP as a dynamic session fair-value reference. Look for price to move away from VWAP into the outer deviation bands, then enter in the direction of reversion when price reaches an extreme band or after a break-and-retest of VWAP/its bands in a reversal context.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage the trade with VWAP and its standard-deviation bands as reference points: take profit back toward VWAP/fair value, or use the first/second/third deviation bands as staged targets depending on how far price extended.

strategies.name: vwap_breakout_followthrough

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct skeletons are taught: a VWAP mean-reversion/rebalancing setup and a VWAP breakout/continuation setup. They share the same indicator but have opposite entry logic, so they split under Rule 2.
